summary: Shows whether things not on this server, such as your router, a NAS or a website, are up or down.
does: Outside services checks the addresses you give it, such as your router, a NAS (network storage device) or a website, and tells you which ones answer. You can give each a name.

It opens each address and waits up to 8 seconds. Any answer counts, even a sign-in page, unless it is a server error. It checks every 5 minutes by default, and you can change that from 1 to 60 minutes.
for: For people who want to know quickly whether a device on their network or a website they rely on is reachable, without checking each one by hand.
needs: Nothing else beyond Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. You give it the addresses to check, up to 20.
shows: Two dashboard cards, both called Outside services: a one line summary, such as how many answer or which do not, and a list of up to 10 addresses with Up and the time taken, or Not answering. Its tab has Addresses to check and Check every.
unclear: The store listing describes ports, ping, DNS, heartbeats, 90 days of history, certificates, maintenance windows, a status page and alerts, but the README and help describe a simple address check. Which is right for the version in the store?
